title: glab api projects/${project}/merge_requests?${query} [--paginate]
description: A list of the project's merge requests, ${project} its path URL-encoded, read in `modules/bash/forge/gitlab.sh`: the open ones with --paginate, which prints one such array per page, for their source branches (forge/gitlab:branch-for-issue, with `modules/jq/forge.jq` forge::gitlab_branch_for_issue) and their iids (forge/gitlab:open-prs); the open one on a branch for its iid (forge/gitlab:pr-for-branch, forge/gitlab:pr-here); those on a branch in any state, newest first, for the newest one's iid, sha, or state (forge/gitlab:pr-last-for-branch, forge/gitlab:pr-head-for-branch, forge/gitlab:pr-state-for-branch with forge::gitlab_pr_state); the one updated last for its iid and updated_at (forge/gitlab:marks, with forge::gitlab_marks); and the 51 merged last, state=merged&order_by=merged_at&per_page=51, for their title, author, source branch, merge time, merger, and page (forge/gitlab:merged-prs, with forge::gitlab_merged). merge_user and merged_by, which GitLab deprecates for it, name the same merger, merge_user also who set an automatic merge; order_by=merged_at is GitLab 17.2's, and an older GitLab, which refuses it, is read with state=merged&order_by=updated_at&sort=desc&per_page=51 instead (forge::gitlab_merged_by_update). The types are APIEntitiesMergeRequestBasic of GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests in GitLab's REST OpenAPI, https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/raw/master/doc/api/openapi/openapi_v3.yaml, and the state's values those of https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_requests/.

iid.description: The merge request's number in its project.

sha.description: The head commit of the source branch.

merged_at.description: When it was merged, null for one not merged.
